transcript:
lee: FYI I kicked off a replay for US daily aggs and noticed the console didn't ask for any retention or show size estimates. It dumped ~95GB into hot storage. :grimacing:
anika: ugh. do we have a preview endpoint? we should surface size + time before users hit run.
lee: Not in the public UI. There is a internal dry_run param that returns rough row counts but not size estimates.
peter: We should return estimated_bytes and an estimated_cost_usd in the preview response. Even a coarse cost is helpful.
ria: +1. For the UI: modal with three lines: estimated size, estimated time, and a required confirmation that types the tenant slug when >20GB. That reduces accidental launches.
ops-bot: replay 2024-REPLAY-300 queued by lee on replay-pool-1.
anika: policy: default artifact retention shouldn't be 90d. Propose 7d by default and a per-tenant opt-in up to 365d.
peter: Add a soft quota: block self-serve runs with estimated >100GB unless admin override. Hard block at 500GB.
ria: We'll need an operator-approved fast-path for urgent business replays so SLAs can be met. Maybe a one-click escalation that creates a ticket and grants temporary higher quota.
lee: Also add a visible cancel button in the job details while it's queued/enqueued. I tried to cancel and couldn't find it.
ops-bot: replay 2024-REPLAY-300 started 1:07 UTC, workers=12.
anika: storage ops: auto-migrate large outputs (>10GB) to infrequent after 24h and to archive after 30d, unless the tenant explicitly marks keep=true. Show lifecycle in console.
peter: For quota enforcement we can reuse token-bucket per-tenant and add a cooldown backoff if they hit short-term burst cap. That prevents repeated costly runs.
ria: UX: require explicit checkbox "retain artifacts >7d" and show the estimated extra cost per day. Also include link "what counts toward quota".
ops-bot: replay 2024-REPLAY-300 finished 1:54 UTC, produced 94.7GB, duration 47m.
finance-bot: Alert: unusually large replay (94.7GB) for tenant acme-inc. Estimated incremental monthly storage cost = $18.70.
anika: Good. Let's draft a small RFC: preview API fields, modal flow, retention defaults, soft/hard caps, admin override flow, auto-archive lifecycle, cleanup plan for existing >30d artifacts.
peter: I'll grab the API changes and schema. Ria, can you prototype the modal copy?
ria: on it. I'll include the tenant-typing confirmation and a small CTA to start a ticket for emergency override.
lee: Also schedule a one-off cleanup job for current artifacts older than 30d unless flagged keep=true. Ops run next Tue?
anika: scheduled. I'll loop in SRE and finance after we have the RFC.
peter: plan phases: phase A = preview + modal + cancel button + retention defaults. phase B = quota UI + admin override + audit feed. phase C = lifecycle automation + cost alerts and cleanup.
ria: thumbs-up. small follow-up: can we add a quick tooltip explaining "estimated" is a best-effort and may vary? saves support tickets.
lee: agreed. thanks team :thumbsup:
